name: Danganronpa Z: Patient Madness Cropper
source:
A Danganronpa fangame that is set in a hospital. 15 students are trapped in a hospital with a psychotic bear named Monokuma, the only way to get out is by getting away with murder.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/omaewakoichi/342745]GameJolt[/url]]
